verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents its own export paths for case data: list and fetch APIs for data syncing, one-click case downloads, a Reports History export, and CSV downloads from analytics tables. Nothing shows that customer, alert or decision data can be exported, or that exports carry stable identifiers for reconciliation, and the API reference is password-gated. Missing for 10: customer/CRM data export, alert data export, decision/disposition data export, documented stable identifiers in exports, public API reference or schema, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export customer, alert, case and decision data with stable identifiers for reconciliation

citations.quote: for information retrieval or data syncing, Hummingbird provides APIs for listing cases and fetching case information over API.
Download case information: This feature allows you to export detailed case information with one-click.
This will download case data for the time frame selected, including case comments.
You can export data from a table you need by clicking on the Download icon in the upper right of each table. This initiates a CSV download.
